mode.description: WHERE the event happens, and one of exactly three values. 'in_person' needs a location; 'online' needs a virtualUrl and has no location; 'hybrid' needs both. Orthogonal to `categories` — an online workshop is mode 'online' + categories ['workshop']. Records written before this field carried meaning default to 'in_person' on read. The legacy value 'virtual' is tolerated on read and means 'online'.

paid.description: Whether the event costs money. The app never processes payment.

links.description: Social / website links for the event.

facets.description: Rich-text facets (links, mentions) over the description, reusing the Bluesky richtext lexicon.

hostedBy.description: DEPRECATED. Display text for who is hosting. The organiser is the record owner, so this is no longer written; kept so old records still read.

location.description: Physical location. Expected for mode 'in_person' and 'hybrid'; absent for 'online'.

startsAt.description: Event start, as an absolute instant. Render in `timezone`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Stored separately from startsAt so calendar export (.ics DTSTART;TZID) and the displayed local time are correct.

createdBy.description: Display text for the event creator/organiser (the account that owns this record).

itinerary.description: Ordered agenda for the event: a list of items, each with optional time, descriptive text, and an optional location. Works for any event type — a photowalk's route, a workshop's schedule, an exhibition's programme. Items that carry coordinates are drawn on the event map as numbered pins in order; an event whose items have no coordinates simply renders the list with no map.

categories.description: WHAT the event is. One or more (max 3) — an event can be both a photowalk and a meetup. Drives browse/filter, which OR-matches any element. Orthogonal to `mode`. The legacy value 'online_meetup' is tolerated on read and means mode 'online' + category 'meetup'.

coverImage.description: Wide cover image shown on the event header and share previews.

rsvpPolicy.description: Who may RSVP. 'atmosphere' = any ATProto account. 'photosky' = members only. 'anyone_email' = anyone, including non-ATProto people via an email address. Enforcement is soft (obscurity-level), like collection visibility.

virtualUrl.description: Join link for events with mode 'online' or 'hybrid'. Required for those modes. Shown only to RSVP'd users in the client.

capacityMode.description: Behaviour when maxParticipants is reached. 'hard' = block new going RSVPs. 'waitlist' = overflow goes on a waitlist, promoted in RSVP order. Only meaningful when maxParticipants is set. Default 'hard'.

maxParticipants.description: Optional cap on confirmed (going) participants. Absent = unlimited.

photoCategories.description: Photography genre tags (Street, Landscape, Portrait, ...). Up to 3, optional. Drawn from the shared category list used by posts. Distinct from `categories`, which is the event type.

approvalRequired.description: When true, an RSVP is pending until the organiser approves it; only approved RSVPs count toward the cap and the attendee list. Approval state is tracked off-protocol (the organiser cannot mutate another user's rsvp record). Default false.

paymentInstructions.description: Free-text explanation of how the organiser collects payment out of band. MUST NOT contain a URL/link; rejected at write time client- and server-side.

main.description: An event: a photowalk, workshop, meetup, exhibition or talk. Written to the organiser's own PDS. Others RSVP via app.zeens.rsvp (ATProto handle) or via an email address tracked off-protocol in PocketBase. The app does NOT collect payment: paid events carry free-text paymentInstructions and any URL/link in that field is rejected at write time. Carries the app.zeens.v marker so firehose + Lua filters recognise it. NOTE: the record id stays 'app.zeens.event' and the app.zeens.* namespace is network plumbing — it is not renamed when the product is. Two orthogonal axes describe an event: `mode` (WHERE it happens — in person, online, or both) and `categories` (WHAT it is — one or more of photowalk/workshop/meetup/exhibition/talk/other). The `hostedBy` field is DEPRECATED (the organiser is the record owner); kept for back-compat with old records.

lat.description: Latitude in microdegrees (degrees x 1e7). ATProto rejects non-integer numbers, so coordinates are scaled to integers.

text.description: What happens at this point in the event (e.g. 'Meet at the park entrance', 'Darkroom demo', 'Q&A with the curator').

time.description: Free-text time label for this item (e.g. '9:00 AM', 'Lunch'). Stored as text, not a datetime, so it renders verbatim without timezone handling.

location.description: Optional location for this item. Only meaningful for events with mode 'in_person' or 'hybrid'. Items with lat/lng are plotted on the event map.
